blocks.text: Ascendra International Corporation marks another milestone in its young but rapidly developing journey as it formally opens its expanded main office at the Global Link Center along Shaw Boulevard in Mandaluyong City. The ribbon-cutting and opening ceremony signals more than the expansion of a physical workplace. For Ascendra, the bigger headquarters represents the company’s preparation for its next phase of growth—strengthening its Philippine operations while laying the groundwork for broader local and international expansion. The milestone comes as Ascendra carries its September campaign, “Bigger and Stronger,” a theme that reflects the company’s current direction of building stronger systems, expanding its reach […]...
